$comment: This chain carries NO SparkPoint vault and NO Aave/Morpho deployment of any kind — the vault
path here is fail-closed by design (constitution v3.0.0 D3, packages/shared/src/chains:
offersVault=false). Nothing in this file is a deposit target or a policy target.
What lives here is the testnet SRK utility token and its faucet, deployed so that the Sparky
Broker activation flow can be rehearsed on a single chain: the broker NFT lives on Robinhood
Chain, so the SRK it retires has to live here too or activation can never be atomic.
`SRK` here is a SEPARATE deployment from the Base Sepolia SRK at 0x2dF9…eD52. Same contract,
same fixed supply, different chain — the two balances are unrelated and must never be added up.
Neither is the CoinMarketCap-listed mainnet SparkPoint token.
